column1: # Per-page render budget for the oracle cases, in milliseconds (item 10c).
# Measured 2026-11-15 on the GitHub `ubuntu-latest` runner, release build, 144 dpi,
# by the oracle job in calibrate mode; the budget is twice the measured time, or
# 25 ms where the page is fast enough that a runner's noise dominates. The point
# is to catch a page that got ten times slower, not to police a millisecond: the
# renderer has no anti-aliasing and the cases are small.
# Raise a number deliberately, in its own commit, with the reason. A budget that
# creeps after every regression measures nothing.
# Measured 2026-11-17 in the run that gated them: 43.3 ms and 36.5 ms at 1x1, so
# the budget is ~2x — these pages are a decoder, not a painter.
